Compact 5 Pc Black Gift Set – Premium Corporate Gifting Solution (Q151)

The Compact 5 Pc Black Gift Set: A5 Size Notebook, Metal Pen, Metal PU Keychain, Metal Card Holder & Straight Steel Bottle | Q151 is a premium and practical gifting solution designed for professionals, corporate events, and executive branding. This elegant combines functionality with a sleek black aesthetic, making it ideal for conferences, employee onboarding, festive gifting, and promotional campaigns.

Crafted with attention to durability and presentation, the set is housed in a durable gift box with EVA hard foam slots that securely holds each item while enhancing the unboxing experience. Whether used as a corporate giveaway or a premium business gift, this compact reflects professionalism and long-lasting value.

  • A5 size with personal memorandum and bookmark ribbon for daily planning and professional note-taking

Every item in this is designed for everyday professional use. The A5 size features high-quality pages along with a personal memorandum section, ensuring organized documentation. The bookmark ribbon adds convenience for quick referencing during meetings or travel.

The complements the perfectly, offering a balanced grip and smooth refill flow. The gunmetal finish plate adds a refined touch while remaining sturdy for long-term usage. The protects cards from bending and wear, making it an essential accessory for sales professionals and executives. Completing the set is the stainless steel capacity 750ml approx., crafted for durability and everyday hydration needs.

Elegant Packaging for Lasting Impression

This comes in a premium black box with EVA hard foam slots that hold each item firmly in place. The structured packaging enhances presentation, making it suitable for direct gifting without additional wrapping. The compact design ensures easy storage and transportation.

Ideal for Corporate & Promotional Gifting

The is widely used for corporate gifting, employee rewards, client appreciation, trade shows, and festive promotions. Its neutral black theme makes it suitable for all industries, while the utility-driven components ensure the gift is both memorable and practical. This set is also an excellent option for logo branding and customization, helping businesses strengthen brand visibility while offering a premium gifting experience.

Why Choose?

If you are looking for a sophisticated and functional corporate gift, the offers the perfect balance of style, durability, and everyday usability. Its premium materials, elegant packaging, and professional appeal make it a reliable choice for businesses seeking high-impact gifting solutions.
